In that way we would just based on the items that we are moving, do you have time to complete the virtual walkthrough today?' Confirmed time: '10:30 today.' top_strength: Rep conducted thorough logistics gathering covering parking, access, special items (freezer, drill press, mirrors), and box count, then cleanly routed to the virtual walkthrough with confirmed time and link handoff.
coaching_note: This is a kickoff call on an already-booked move, not a full intake—but rep should have asked for the customer's name early and used it throughout; more importantly, on any inbound interaction, establish the Two Promises (On-Time and Damage Protection) before deep probing, regardless of routing decision.
